title: NOXA Fun LaunchLocker — fee-collector auth and permanently locked LP principal
closed_reasons: collectFees is gated to owner || launched.deployer || feeCollectors[msg.sender]; a fresh caller reverts NotAuthorized
setFeeRedirect is gated to launched.deployer; a fresh caller reverts NotDeployer
setFeeCollector is onlyOwner; the only registered collector is the protocol manager 0x9eFd...
lockPosition is NotFactory-gated; the factory record always uses the canonical Uniswap V3 NPM
no function can transfer the 60,142 position NFTs, decrease liquidity, or sweep principal; getApproved = 0
protocolFeeShare = 100 on Robinhood, so all fees go to protocolFeeRecipient, not the caller
verified source (Sourcify runtime match) and 6/6 fork tests
key_facts: Robinhood locker 0x7F03effbd7ceB22A3f80Dd468f67eF27826acD85: owner 0x7E035Fb048a31e0481b88074557415b1C187242B (EOA, code size 0), factory 0xD9eC2db5f3D1b236843925949fe5bd8a3836FCcB, protocolFeeShare 100, protocolFeeRecipient 0x9eFdC1A8e6E94f16A228e44f3025E1f346EE0417
60,142 UniV3 position NFTs held at block 93,005,273; sample position 212 owned by the locker with zero approval
feeCollectors(0x9eFd...) = true; feeCollectors(0x1111...) = false; only one FeeCollectorUpdated event ever
fresh-caller probes: collectFees -> NotAuthorized; setFeeRedirect -> NotDeployer; lockPosition -> NotFactory; setFeeCollector -> OwnableUnauthorized; NFT transferFrom -> not owner/approved
90,429 FeesClaimed events (block 70,236..92,960,011), 46,198 unique tokens, 644 callers, 88,854 calls by the protocol manager 0x9eFd...
sample estimate of unclaimed WETH fees: 0.0251736548 WETH in 120 positions -> ~12.62 WETH (~$30.4k) scaled to 60,142; all payable to protocolFeeRecipient because pfs=100
all seven lockers share runtime code hash sha256:5124fdbb984a6eb3 (4,823 bytes); pfs=100 on Robinhood/Monad, 0 on MegaETH/Stable/Intuition/Merlin (TVL $2k-$2.6k each)
protocol manager 0x9eFd... holds 29.79 ETH (~$71.7k); its native sweep 0xab803a76 reverts OwnableUnauthorizedAccount for a fresh caller; routeFees 0x06ec16f8 reverts under pfs=100
principal is locked by design: no withdraw/decreaseLiquidity/transfer function; TVL $3,903,181 on Robinhood, $3,934,698 across seven chains
caveats: The 12.62 WETH fee estimate is a 120-position sample scaled to 60,142; the exact pot varies with the protocol keeper's harvest schedule
DefiLlama TVL is an adapter estimate (base-token side of single-sided UniV3 positions, doubled), not a realizable liquidation value
Arc RPC was unreachable; its $21,168 TVL is unverified; other chains' TVLs are small
The factory is unverified; its launch path was inferred from the verified locker interface and 526 decoded PositionLocked events, all using the canonical NPM
P value is the owner-key fee pot (~$30.4k), not the locked principal; the manager's 29.79 ETH is protocol treasury and is not counted in P
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 from NOXA: collectFees/setFeeRedirect/setFeeCollector are properly gated and paid to the protocol/deployer, and the $3.9M LP principal is permanently locked with no NFT-transfer or liquidity-decrease function; only an owner-key compromise could capture ~$30k of unclaimed fees.
